data.text: Scheduling note: logistics-only family access still active through Monday. Current tentative slot is Wednesday March 11, 8:50 AM arrival for 10:20 AM procedure in cardiac procedures.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: So right now I keep taking apixaban, I raise the metoprolol tonight, I stop ibuprofen, and I begin the magnesium tonight?

prior_context.speaker: clinician_dr_patel
prior_context.text: Correct. Also do not miss any apixaban doses at all between now and cardioversion.

prior_context.speaker: agent_memcare
prior_context.text: Cardiology plan update: continue apixaban 5 mg BID without interruption, increase metoprolol tartrate to 37.5 mg BID starting tonight, stop ibuprofen/NSAIDs, use acetaminophen if needed, start magnesium oxide 400 mg nightly for five nights, continue lisinopril 10 mg daily but hold morning dose on procedure day.

prior_context.speaker: labtech_mira
prior_context.text: Your labs are back: hemoglobin 14.1, potassium 4.1, magnesium 1.7, creatinine 1.0, and TSH 1.9.

prior_context.speaker: clinician_dr_patel
prior_context.text: Those labs are acceptable for outpatient cardioversion, and the magnesium result supports the supplement plan we just discussed.

prior_context.speaker: scheduler_terry
prior_context.text: I just got a tentative slot. Direct cardioversion is being held for Wednesday, March 11 at 10:20 AM with 8:50 AM arrival in the cardiac procedures unit.

prior_context.speaker: scheduler_terry
prior_context.text: Prep for that slot would be nothing by mouth after midnight except small sips of water for approved morning medications. We will confirm whether that slot stays direct cardioversion or changes to a TEE-guided case.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: Please put that in the chart, and Nina can hear only the Wednesday time and arrival window, nothing about the medication plan.

prior_context.speaker: scheduler_terry
prior_context.text: At the moment, yes: Wednesday morning, 8:50 arrival for a 10:20 procedure. Any clinical questions need to go through Marcus.
